coverageRationale.en: Rewrites ISO/IEC 14888-3 as a reproducible standards card: the signature equation, DSA/ECDSA/SM2/EdDSA formulas, 15 mechanism families and the key-substitution boundary; the 2018 base has 14, and the 2026 amendment adds EdDSA.

credit.zh: 原创示意图（目录级模型）

zh.principle: **标准**：基于离散对数的数字签名（Digital signatures with appendix — Part 3: Discrete logarithm based mechanisms）。ISO/IEC 14888-3:2018 规定基于离散对数问题的带附录签名机制；2018 正文 14 个，2026 年 11 月补篇加入 EdDSA 后为 15 个：12 个证书基 + 3 个身份基。所有机制都是随机化的，签名附在消息后，消息不能被签名“恢复”。通用模型不是“算一个哈希再签”，而是五个步骤：产生随机数 K；算预签名 Π；准备消息 M1/M2；算见证 R（第一段签名）；算 assignment (T1,T2) 与第二段签名 S。通用签名方程是 A·K+B·X+C≡0 (mod q)，其中 X 是私钥，A/B/C 由 (S,T1,T2) 的排列决定。DSA 在乘法群 Z_p* 上，R=(g^K mod p) mod q，S=K^{-1}(h(M)+XR) mod q；验证重算 R。ECDSA 在椭圆曲线点上，R=x([K]G) mod q，S=K^{-1}(e+Rd) mod q。SM2 的 M1=Z||M，Z 绑定身份 ID、曲线参数与公钥；签名 r=(e+x1) mod n，s=(1+d)^{-1}(k-rd) mod n。EdDSA 在 twisted Edwards 曲线上，R=[k]G，S=(k+H(R||A||M)x) mod L。公式化记法：Sig=(R,S)，Verify(pk,M,(R,S))∈{0,1}；标准只给机制，不给实现侧信道防护。
zh.why: 把 14/15 个机制放在一起，价值在于看出“同一个方程、不同群与见证函数”。DSA/ECDSA/SM2/EdDSA 不是四套无关算法：它们都从随机 K 与私钥 X 出发，用一个可验证的方程把 R 与 S 绑定到消息。2018 第四版加入 SM2 与 Chinese IBS；2026 补篇加入 EdDSA，并把 key substitution 注记改写为“可能易受攻击”，说明标准本身不提供该防护。EdDSA 在设计上把公钥 A 绑进哈希，因而自带一层 key-substitution 防护。身份基机制（IBS-1、IBS-2、Chinese IBS）与证书基的信任模型不同：身份基由 KGC 生成私钥，天然带密钥托管；证书基由 CA 认证公钥。公式级必须把这两种信任模型分开写。
zh.used: 实现顺序：1) 选机制与群；2) 校验域参数与公钥；3) 生成私钥 X 与公钥 Y；4) 每条签名用新鲜随机 K；5) 计算 R/S；6) 编码为 DER 或标准附录格式；7) 验证方重算方程并检查 R/S 范围。SM2 还要先算 Z=Hash(ENTL||ID||a||b||x_G||y_G||x_A||y_A)，再算 M1=Z||M；EdDSA 要按 RFC 8032/标准做 Edwards 点编码与 cofactor 处理。身份基要验证 KGC 参数与私钥派生。工程检查：K 是否真随机且唯一；R/S 是否在 [1,q-1]；哈希是否抗碰撞；公钥是否绑进签名或消息；是否做 key-substitution 防护；是否验证证书链/KGC 身份；是否做常数时间实现。
zh.broken: nonce 重用是致命错误：同一 K 签两条消息，私钥可由两条 S 方程直接解出。K 偏差、低熵 RNG、故障注入也会泄露私钥。EC-DSA、EC-GDSA、EC-RDSA、EC-FSDSA 可能遭 key substitution：攻击者找两个不同公钥与一个签名，使签名对两者都有效；标准建议把公钥加入被签消息。身份基机制有 KGC 托管，KGC 可生成任意用户的私钥。标准不覆盖侧信道、故障注入、实现 API 误用、签名编码歧义；不提供“签名即安全”的证明。EdDSA 补篇是 2026 年新增，不改变 2018 正文其他机制的计数。
zh.history: 1998 年第一版是证书基，含 DSA 与 Pointcheval/Vaudenay；2006 年第二版重组为离散对数机制，加入 KCDSA、IBS-1、IBS-2；2010 年 Amd 1 加入 SRA、EC-RDSA、EC-SDSA、EC-FSDSA；2016 年第三版；2018 年第四版加入 SM2 与 Chinese IBS，共 14 个；2026 年 11 月 Amd 1 加入 EdDSA，共 15 个。

zh.example:
**形式模型与复算步骤**

\[S=\min_i S_i,\quad S_i\in\{\text{密钥强度},\text{分组安全},\text{实现安全}\}\]

基于离散对数的数字签名的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：S 为综合安全强度；各分量取最小值，不能只看密钥位数。1.读取标准规定的密钥/分组/模式参数。2.按标准表换算等效强度。3.取最弱分量作为系统强度。边界：公式只覆盖已登记的参数与假设；参数取值、标准版本和实现细节仍以来源为准。

en.principle: **Standard**: Digital signatures with appendix — Part 3: Discrete logarithm based mechanisms (基于离散对数的数字签名). ISO/IEC 14888-3:2018 specifies digital signatures with appendix based on the discrete logarithm problem. The 2018 body has 14 mechanisms; the November 2026 amendment adds EdDSA, making 15: 12 certificate-based and 3 identity-based. All are randomized; the signature is appended to the message and the message is not recovered from the signature. The general model is not “hash and sign”: it has five stages: produce randomizer K; compute pre-signature Π; prepare M1/M2; compute witness R (first signature part); compute assignment (T1,T2) and second part S. The general signature equation is A·K+B·X+C≡0 (mod q), where X is the private key and A/B/C come from a permutation of (S,T1,T2). DSA works in Z_p*: R=(g^K mod p) mod q and S=K^{-1}(h(M)+XR) mod q; verification recomputes R. ECDSA works on curve points: R=x([K]G) mod q and S=K^{-1}(e+Rd) mod q. SM2 prepares M1=Z||M, where Z binds the identity ID, curve parameters and public key; it signs r=(e+x1) mod n and s=(1+d)^{-1}(k-rd) mod n. EdDSA works on a twisted Edwards curve: R=[k]G and S=(k+H(R||A||M)x) mod L. A compact notation is Sig=(R,S) and Verify(pk,M,(R,S))∈{0,1}; the standard gives mechanisms, not side-channel protection.
en.why:
Putting 14/15 mechanisms together reveals “one equation, different groups and witness functions”. DSA/ECDSA/SM2/EdDSA are not four unrelated algorithms: each starts from a random K and private X and uses a verifiable equation to bind R and S to the message.

The 2018 fourth edition added SM2 and Chinese IBS; the 2026 amendment added EdDSA and reworded the key-substitution note as “can be vulnerable”, making clear that the standard does not supply that protection. EdDSA binds the public key A into the hash by design and therefore carries a layer of key-substitution protection.

Identity-based mechanisms (IBS-1, IBS-2, Chinese IBS) have a different trust model: the KGC generates private keys and therefore escrows them; certificate-based mechanisms have a CA authenticate public keys. Formula-level writing must keep these trust models separate.
en.used:
Implementation order: 1) choose mechanism and group; 2) validate domain parameters and public keys; 3) generate private X and public Y; 4) use a fresh random K for every signature; 5) compute R/S; 6) encode in DER or the standard appendix format; 7) the verifier recomputes the equation and checks R/S ranges.

SM2 first computes Z=Hash(ENTL||ID||a||b||x_G||y_G||x_A||y_A), then M1=Z||M; EdDSA follows the standard/RFC 8032 Edwards encoding and cofactor handling. Identity-based schemes must validate KGC parameters and private-key derivation.

Engineering checks: is K truly random and unique; are R/S in [1,q-1]; is the hash collision-resistant; is the public key bound into the signed message; is key-substitution protection present; are certificate chain/KGC identities verified; is the implementation constant-time.
en.broken:
Nonce reuse is fatal: two messages signed with the same K let an attacker solve the two S equations for the private key. K bias, low-entropy RNG and fault injection can also leak the key.

EC-DSA, EC-GDSA, EC-RDSA and EC-FSDSA can be vulnerable to key substitution: an attacker finds two distinct public keys and one signature valid for both; the standard suggests adding the public key to the signed message. Identity-based mechanisms have KGC escrow, so the KGC can create any user’s private key.

The standard does not cover side channels, fault injection, API misuse or signature-encoding ambiguity, and does not prove “signature equals security”. The EdDSA amendment is a 2026 addition and does not change the count of the other 2018 mechanisms.
en.history: The 1998 first edition was certificate-based and contained DSA and Pointcheval/Vaudenay; the 2006 second edition reorganized the part around discrete-log mechanisms and added KCDSA, IBS-1 and IBS-2; Amd 1:2010 added SRA, EC-RDSA, EC-SDSA and EC-FSDSA; the third edition appeared in 2016; the 2018 fourth edition added SM2 and Chinese IBS for 14 mechanisms; Amd 1:2026, published in November 2026, added EdDSA for 15.
